description:
Create a visual site architecture graph for the e-commerce sandbox site 'https://books.toscrape.com/'. 

STEPS:
1. Configure the spider to limit the crawl to 200 URLs (Configuration > Spider > Limits > Limit Crawl Total).
2. Crawl 'https://books.toscrape.com/'.
3. Once the crawl finishes (or reaches the limit), generate a Force-Directed Crawl Diagram (Visualisations > Crawl Diagrams > Force-Directed Crawl Diagram).
4. In the visualization window, save/export the graph as an HTML file named 'site_graph.html' to '/home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/'.
